skill.name: backend-api
skill.description: Design and implement RESTful API endpoints following best practices for routing, versioning, and HTTP standards. Use this skill when creating or modifying API routes, controllers, or endpoints in files like routes/api.php, API controller files in app/Http/Controllers/Api/, controller files in app/Http/Controllers/, API resource classes, or when implementing REST API functionality. Use when working on URL structures, HTTP method handling (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), API versioning strategies, query parameter handling for filtering/sorting/pagination, HTTP status code responses, rate limiting configuration, or any API endpoint design decisions.
skill.summary: Guide REST API route, controller, versioning, and response design.
skill.author: DevanB

security_audit.summary: Four external command findings are false positives because they are Markdown inline code formatting for routes and paths. The filesystem finding is confirmed because SKILL.md points to ../../../agent-os/standards/backend/api.md, which directs the agent outside the skill package. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Move the referenced backend API standard into the skill directory, or replace the parent-directory link with bundled guidance.

static_findings.snippet: - When creating or editing API route definitions in `routes/api.php` or similar routing files
- When building or modifying controllers in `app/Http/Controllers/` or controller directories
- When building or modifying API controllers in `app/Http/Controllers/Api/` or API-specific controll
- When implementing API versioning (URL path versioning like `/api/v1/` or header-based versioning)

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks on line 12 are Markdown inline code around a route file path. There is no shell command, Ruby execution, or user-controlled command input.
The backticks on line 13 are Markdown inline code around a controller directory path. The text is documentation only and does not execute a command.
The backticks on line 14 are Markdown inline code around an API controller path. No command invocation or interpolation is present.
The backticks on line 17 format an example API URL path. This is not Ruby shell backtick execution and has no execution behavior.

The Markdown link uses ../../../ to instruct the agent to consult a file outside the skill package. That out-of-package filesystem reference can cause unbundled local file reads and weakens package integrity.

content.value_statement: Backend API work often stalls on routing, versioning, and response standards. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through consistent REST endpoint design and implementation.
actual_capabilities: Guide route definitions for REST API endpoints in Laravel-style routing files.
Recommend HTTP methods and status codes for CRUD endpoint behavior.
Plan URL structures, nested resources, and API versioning approaches.
Define query parameters for filtering, sorting, pagination, and search.
Support controller and API resource patterns for response formatting.
limitations: It only provides guidance; it does not include executable generators or tests.
The referenced detailed standard is outside the skill package.
It focuses on REST APIs, not GraphQL, WebSockets, or event streams.
Framework-specific advice is strongest for Laravel-style file layouts.

use_cases.title: Create REST Endpoints
use_cases.description: Plan routes, controllers, HTTP methods, and response codes for new backend resources.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Responses
use_cases.description: Align pagination, filtering, sorting, errors, and resource formatting across endpoints.

use_cases.title: Review API Changes
use_cases.description: Check endpoint design for REST conventions, versioning choices, and throttling expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a REST endpoint for this resource. Include the route purpose, HTTP method, controller action, expected status codes, and response shape.

prompt_templates.title: Add Query Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Add filtering, sorting, pagination, and search behavior to this API endpoint. Explain the query parameters and validation rules.

prompt_templates.title: Design Versioned Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan versioning for this API resource. Compare URL path versioning and header-based versioning, then recommend one approach.

prompt_templates.title: Review an API Surface
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these API routes and controllers for REST conventions, versioning, status codes, pagination, and rate limiting. List prioritized fixes with rationale.

output: Use a GET collection endpoint for the users resource.
Return a success status when the request is valid.
Support pagination and optional filters before adding custom search behavior.

output_examples.output: The review would compare path and header versioning, flag inconsistent route names, and recommend a single versioning pattern.

output_examples.input: Add rate limiting guidance to an API plan.
output_examples.output: The output would define throttling expectations, response headers, and error behavior for requests that exceed the limit.

best_practices: Keep resource names consistent and use standard HTTP methods for each action.
Define pagination, filtering, sorting, and search behavior before implementation.
Map success and error paths to clear HTTP status codes.
anti_patterns: Mixing custom verbs into URLs when standard HTTP methods already describe the action.
Returning generic success or error codes that hide the real request outcome.
Adding versioning, filtering, or throttling behavior differently for each endpoint.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill fit best?
faq.answer: It fits Laravel-style backend projects best, especially projects with API routes, controllers, and resource classes.

faq.question: Can it generate complete API code?
faq.answer: It can guide implementation, but it does not include executable scaffolding or project-specific test generation.

faq.question: Does it support API versioning decisions?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers URL path versioning and header-based versioning at the design level.

faq.question: Can it help with pagination and filtering?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for filtering, sorting, pagination, and search query parameters.

faq.question: Does it cover security controls?
faq.answer: It mentions rate limiting and throttling, but it is not a full API security review skill.

faq.question: Why is there a marketplace security warning?
faq.answer: The skill references a documentation file outside its package. Authors should bundle that file inside the skill.
